_why: THE DEBT RATCHET. These markers are honest conventions — TODO(keys) scaffolds around a missing credential, NOT CHECKED refuses to report a skipped check as done. That honesty is why they grow: writing one is virtuous and nothing ever closes one. Each pile now carries a counted budget and a reason. Over budget FAILS the push; under budget ratchets down. The number can only go down. Ships baselined against this repository's own tree (2026-11-25, owner-approved), so a fresh clone passes its own gate. If you add projects of your own, re-baseline once with `node .claude/skills/security-gate/debt-ratchet.mjs --baseline` and commit the result on its own.

todo-keys.reason: A credential the build was scaffolded around, per the scaffold-around-and-continue rule (marker + a SETUP-KEYS.md row). Baselined 2026-11-25 against this repository's own tree at 15, owner-approved, so pushes to the public repo are judged by the ratchet instead of failing on seed zeros. Frozen: no NEW ones without closing an old one or raising this deliberately.
